canonical_rule: Postgres books.book_id (and matching Storage folder segment) is the catalog identity for joins, Validation, and dataset_versions. Extraction-era book_id strings are aliases only.
entity_id_policy: Entity IDs (unit_id, page_id, vocabulary_id, …) keep their extraction-era prefixes for stability. Merge-time normalization rewrites book_id fields only — not entity ID strings. New books (D009) should use the full catalog_book_id as the entity prefix and prefer emitting the catalog ID directly (no new abbreviated aliases).
naming_policy: D009 — docs/9-naming-conventions.md. Pilots are grandfathered. Forward catalog templates: beehive_{level}_sb, big_english_{level}_{sb|wb}, reach_higher_{level}.

books.notes: Most fields use beehive_1_sb; some batches also used beehive_american_sb1.
Batches/canonical entities often use bep1_sb / bep1_* prefixes.
Extraction book_id is bep_sb_2; entity IDs often bep2_*.
Units 1–3 used rh_2a; Unit 4 used reach_higher_2a. Normalize book_id fields to reach_higher_2a at merge.
Next extraction target. Prefer catalog ID only — do not introduce bep1_wb / be1_wb aliases. Entity IDs must use big_english_1_wb_* forms.
